diagnostics.message:
[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run1]
`module.secure_baseline.module.analyzer_baseline_ap-northeast-1:resource.aws_accessanalyzer_analyzer.default` is created with `type = "ORGANIZATION"` (`is_organization = local.is_master_account`), which requires the organization and the `access-analyzer.amazonaws.com` service access enabled by `:resource.aws_organizations_organization.org`. It has no dependency on that resource; the official provider documentation for this resource type shows `depends_on = [aws_organizations_organization.example]` as the required pattern for ORGANIZATION-type analyzers.

----------------------------------------

[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run2]
The analyzer in module.secure_baseline.module.analyzer_baseline_ap-northeast-1 is created with type "ORGANIZATION" (is_organization=true), which requires the AWS Organizations organization to already exist. No attribute reference or depends_on connects this analyzer to the organization resource, so Terraform may provision the analyzer before :resource.aws_organizations_organization.org, causing an API failure or a wrong-scope analyzer. Add depends_on = [aws_organizations_organization.org] to the analyzer resource (or to the module call).
